llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must store zoom and translation in Reanimated shared values (`scale`, `translateX`, `translateY`) and apply them through `useAnimatedStyle` transform.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: scale is a dedicated shared value, but translateX/translateY are not separate shared values — translation is stored as a single object shared value `offset` with x/y fields, not as `translateX` and `translateY` named shared values

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must clamp zoom using the existing `MIN_SCALE` constant inside `Gesture.Pinch().onUpdate(...)`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: MIN_SCALE is used in Math.max(MIN_SCALE, ...) inside Gesture.Pinch().onUpdate

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must clamp zoom using the existing `MAX_SCALE` constant inside `Gesture.Pinch().onUpdate(...)`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: MAX_SCALE is used in Math.min(MAX_SCALE, ...) inside Gesture.Pinch().onUpdate

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must use the existing `VIEWPORT_SIZE` to constrain movement while zoomed inside `Gesture.Pan().onUpdate(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: VIEWPORT_SIZE is only used in onFinalize to snap back after release, not inside onUpdate to constrain movement while dragging
evidence: panGesture.onUpdate only modifies offset by e.changeX/e.changeY with no VIEWPORT_SIZE check
VIEWPORT_SIZE appears only in onFinalize: const halfContent = (VIEWPORT_SIZE * scale.value - VIEWPORT_SIZE) / 2
